verdict.rationale: Vue's official testing guide has an E2E recommendation section endorsing Playwright, Nightwatch and Cypress, so the framework documents an E2E path. These are third-party tools recommended by the docs rather than first-party Vue tools, and nothing shows them working out of the box with the dev server. Missing for 10: first-party/official E2E tooling, documented zero-config integration with the dev server, scaffolding or setup evidence, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate official end-to-end testing tools that work out of the box with the framework's dev server

citations.quote: Playwright is a great E2E testing solution that supports Chromium, WebKit, and Firefox.
Nightwatch is an E2E test runner with Vue Component Testing support.
